noord: Use case: historical-scene photo restoration/edit. Edit this exact archival photograph of Rotterdam's Delftse Poort north facade (RCE 20191099, Cornelis Steenbergh, published1915). Produce one full-color realistic photograph as if a modern high-quality camera photographed precisely this historical instant. Preserve entire frame, viewpoint, perspective, every architectural shape and proportion, pediment, clock face, heraldic lions, masonry, columns, central arch, background buildings, streets, canal, people positions/clothes, carts, trees, wires, signs. Do not add or remove subjects. Only clean scratches, dust and faded contrast; conservative natural sharpness and restrained plausible colors. Gate weathered pale warm gray sandstone, dark weathered details, brick buildings muted reddish-brown, roofs slategray and brown, overcast pale blue-gray sky, gray-brown paving, subdued period clothes. Do not invent readable lettering or details absent from reference. Keep faces small and faithful. Retain soft motion blur for originally moving people. No modern surroundings, cars, decorative additions, oversaturation, poster look, or crop. Full building must remain visible. Colors are interpretive. Landscape 4:3.
zuid: Use case: historical-scene photo restoration/edit. Edit this exact archival photograph of Rotterdam's Delftse Poort SOUTH facade (RCE 20191101, photographer C. Hoogendijk). Produce one full-color realistic photograph as if a modern high-quality camera photographed precisely this historical instant. Preserve entire portrait frame, viewpoint, perspective, every architectural shape and proportion, triangular pediment, Roman-numeral clock face and time, central sculptural allegorical relief and flanking shields, masonry courses, four lower columns, two small round side windows and doors, one central arch, roofline, flagpole, background buildings, old street, trees and signs. Whole building remains visible. Change only restoration of scratches/dust/faded contrast, natural sharpness and restrained plausible color. Gate weathered pale warm-gray sandstone with soot-darkened recesses, dark doors, pale blue-gray sky, gray-brown paving, natural subdued green trees. Keep all existing fine details; do not invent readable lettering, architectural motifs, people or any modern objects. Do not crop, extend view, modernize scene, add decoration, oversaturate, or make illustration. Historic colors are interpretive. Portrait aspect ratio same as source.
